verdict.rationale: The docs show users can define vesting schedules and save frequently used ones as predefined templates that prepopulate grant vesting details. The platform also surfaces exercisable options on grants, which implies some tracking of vested amounts. However, cliffs, milestone-based vesting and acceleration on exit are never mentioned, and automatic vested-vs-unvested tracking is only implied. Missing for 10: documented cliff configuration, milestone/performance-based vesting, single/double-trigger acceleration on exit, explicit automatic vested vs unvested tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can define custom vesting schedules — cliffs, milestones, acceleration on exit — and the platform tracks vested vs unvested automatically

citations.quote: Vesting schedules that you use frequently can be saved as a predefined schedule.
Selecting from a predefined vesting schedule will expedite both processes by prepopulating the vesting details for you and ensure consistency among grants
Grants with an Exercise Now button have options available for exercise.
